body:
`scripts/gen-followup-board.sh` makes exactly one data call:

    gh issue list --repo "$REPO" --state open --limit 300 --json ...

`gh issue list` does not return pull requests. So every section the board
computes — `never_acked`, `owe_reply`, `breaches` — is derived from issues
only, and a contributor waiting on a **PR** cannot appear in any of them.

The board is the mechanism the tick trusts to answer "is a person waiting?",
and `state/next-pick.json` inherits the same blindness because it is
board-backed. A tick that clears every board row can still leave several
people waiting and will report zero obligations while doing it.

## Measured 2026-08-13

Board generated 12:55:07Z reported `never_acked=0 owe_reply=0 breaches=0`.
At that moment three community PRs had a person waiting on us:

* **#1442** — @chloeroform asked to merge on 08-12T23:21Z and again on
  08-13T06:40Z; @Thovi98 asked a direct question at 09:43Z. Unanswered at
  board time. The underlying rule-6 hold had been open since 08-08 (5 days).
* **#1482** — waiting on our side since 06:49Z, CI green.
* **#1503** — @siuwai1999's `safe-tier-1` translation PR, green and
  `community-reviewed`, idle 4 days with no one looking at it.

All three were found only by hand-listing open PRs, off-board.

## Why it matters more than the issue side

An issue with no reply is visible in the tracker and the reporter can bump it.
A PR that is green and merely unattended looks *fine* from outside — the
contributor sees a passing build and assumes it is queued, so they wait longer
before asking. #1442 took three asks across five days.

## Fix

Extend the board to a second `gh pr list` call and fold PRs into the same
sections, keyed on the same "last comment is not ours" predicate already used
for issues. A PR needs one extra state the issue path does not have: green +
mergeable + no maintainer action since the contributor's last push is itself
an owed action, even when nobody has commented.

Related: the rule-6 hold on #1442 was recorded in `notes/dep-review-1442.md`
and restated on the thread but never delivered to the operator (no ntfy since
2026-07-19), which is a separate defect in the same family — a hold with no
delivery step and no expiry.
title: Follow-up board is blind to PRs, so a waiting contributor is invisible to it
